quest.title: A Prayer for Rain on the Fecund Land
quest.description: The "branches and leaves" of the Varuna Contraption that were scattered in Vana were all healed. In Arapandu's words, it's time to get rid of the bad bugs gnawing on the roots of the Varuna Contraption...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x40000, Hero's Wit x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, Stories of You and the Aranara x1

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, and Paimon, thank you for helping Aranara. Arapandu senses that the branches blocking the stream in various places have been removed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh! So we can go and heal the Varuna Contraption now, right?

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Soon, but not yet. The root system is deep underground, and the entrance is in the center of the Varunastra.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Varunastra... You've mentioned that before, haven't you, Arapandu?

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #It's a manifestation of the power of the Varuna Contraption. When it displays its power, it will be taller than the tallest tree in Vana. Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon saw it before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you mean that place from which water jets out occasionally? Are we seriously going through the center of that thing!?

choices.text: That doesn't look like an entrance.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What if it activates just as we go in...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The water jet is so high, and it looks really powerful too... Paimon can't figure out how we're going to get into its center...

choices.text: Guess we can only get in from above.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Paimon can fly, but you sure can't!

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Why? We can just make it stop.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It can stop!?

response.speaker: Arapandu
response.text: #It couldn't before, but thanks to Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon's help, the power of the Varuna Contraption has been partially restored. Now, Aranara can make it stop.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, we did such an amazing thing by coincidence!

choices.text: Well, it's not so much of a coincidence...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, true. It was really difficult to find the Grove of Dreams...

response.speaker: Arapandu
response.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, let's go together. The green branches have bloomed. It's almost time to bear fruit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're amazing too. Hehe, we're both amazing!

choices.text: So we're taking this thing head-on, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's heard that some people train by sitting under a waterfall and absorbing its impact... But we'll surely be swept away if we just rush in!

choices.text: Maybe we can dig a tunnel to it from the side...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What kind of solution is that? ... Wait. It might be worth a try...

choices.text: We can't get in! There's no way to get in!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's even more impressive when you see it up close...

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: The Varuna Contraption is a creation of the Lord of Dendro. It sends forth water that brings life, turning Valuka into Vana, replacing that which was once yellow with green, and turning barren land into a land full of life.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It sounds miraculous. "Water that brings life"... Wow...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Can this water be consumed? Will it have any special effects?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Would that happen to you, or Paimon?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon gets any younger than she is now...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You'd become like a Cicin.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh come on, Paimon won't become that small!

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: So Paimon wants water...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: If Paimon becomes a seed, Aranakula will take good care of her, water her properly, and put her in a sunny place and loosen the soil for her.

response.speaker: Arakunti
response.text: Arakunti will play music to Paimon and tell her things about Vana that she doesn't know.

response.speaker: Arakunti
response.text: Arabalika won't come to see Paimon so often. But will bring mushrooms. Cook for her.

response.speaker: Arabalika
response.text: Arabalika will not do such things.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh, that sure sounds like such a cozy life! ...Wait! Paimon won't turn into a seed! What is this, some kind of scary forest that you can't leave once you enter!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...It's even scarier when you think that these words are coming from these sweet-looking Aranara!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You'll grow strong and bear fruit quickly, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey! Don't you start saying that scary stuff too!

response.speaker: Arapandu
response.text: Nara and Paimon won't stay in Vana like Aranara do. Aranakula knows this.

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: #Aranakula knows... Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon have other missions and will leave Vana, like other Nara...

response.speaker: Arapandu
response.text: We have to complete the Aranara mission now and stop the Varuna Contraption in order to go down and remove those bad bugs and heal the machine.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If that's the case...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hah, "Good baby {NICKNAME}, Paimon's here to take care of you! C'mere, let Paimon give you some hugsy-wugsies!"

choices.text: It might let you live forever.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, it might be possible to live long enough to eat every dish in Teyvat that way!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But where will those who share the taste be then...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm... Guess living too long is not entirely a good thing, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The entrance to the underground... It's opened up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I feel like something's missing...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, that's true! Look at this giant, empty hole... Well, at least it's not a hole in our hearts.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Let's go down together, Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: But we must be careful on the road ahead. It is dark and sunless underground. The place where seeds used to sleep peacefully has likely become the lair of the Fungi.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon are Aranara's friends. Aranara do not have great power, but if you are in danger, Aranara will try to protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Nothing to fear. Arabalika is around.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been through gales and high water! This won't scare us.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: There shouldn't be any great winds down there. Water, maybe, but no big waves.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hm... So you're still taking our words at face value, huh, Arakunti...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: "Gales and high water" means that a person has been through a lot.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Arakunti understands now. Paimon's words are difficult to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon would say the same to you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, Fungi aren't scary at all! If this really is their lair... we'll have all-you-can-eat mushrooms for dinner tonight!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, let's hurry down once you're ready!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Th—This is much deeper than the Ruins of Dahri... Paimon didn't expect this place to be so deep underground.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And there are so many spores! Just seeing them is unbearable enough...

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: The spores are covering the Varuna Contraption...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: It must've been left by the bad guys... Ugh... The bad guys could be close by...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Toughen up, Aranakula. Do not back down. We are already here. We solve the problem, whether it be spores or Fungi. This is all for Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: The Varuna Contraption must be very sad to be covered by spores like this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yes... Being covered by spores... Just the thought of it is kinda scary...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's hurry and clear the spores away.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yup! We'll handle this just like when we cleaned the Yasna Monument up, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Aranara are not too late, but... bad seeds grow faster than good seeds. Oh, Nara {NICKNAME}, please clear the bad seeds away...

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Arapandu will look for answers about Vimara Village too. Please be patient.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: #Is Nara {NICKNAME} going to take care of the nursery with Aranakula? There is nothing there yet...

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: But if you plant seeds, they will soon grow into beautiful flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}. Do not be as careless as Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Golden Nara! Heeey ♪

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Mushrooms yummy! Hey hey ♪

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Arakunti seems to be fully immersed in the music.)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon thinks we're safe... for now?

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, thank you for your bravery. The bad bugs gnawing on the roots of the Varuna Contraption have been cleared away.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: The branches scattered all over Vana are also sending us their power. Now Aranara can heal the Varuna Contraption.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It was no trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon told you, the Fungi are nothing! Paimon wouldn't be scared even if there were ten more of them! Heh!

choices.text: Just treat it as a warm-up.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Paimon knew you wouldn't be scared of the Fungi, {NICKNAME}. Hehe...

response.speaker: Aranakula
response.text: Everyone was doing their best to fight the bad guys earlier. And then there was Paimon...

response.speaker: Arakunti
response.text: Not a drop of effort!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #That's not true! P—Paimon gave it her all to cheer for {NICKNAME}! C'mon, {NICKNAME}, you felt Paimon's sincerity, didn't you!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, see? We're one heart and one mind!

response.speaker: Arapandu
response.text: #Anyway, Arapandu thanks Nara {NICKNAME} and Paimon for helping Aranara so much. Now it's Aranara's turn.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hooray! We'll be able to say goodbye to those nose-tickling spores soon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That can't be! You should've put more effort into feeling Paimon's sincerity... It was definitely there, you know!

choices.text: If there really were ten more of them, I'd just leave it to Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Come on. No way!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow! The air is much cleaner now!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can breathe freely now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, peace returns to the Ashavan Realm! Paimon doesn't know about those Fungi in the forest though...

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: After that, the bad guys may leave, or they may not. But the Varuna Contraption has already been healed, and there won't be so many spores anymore. Aranara will not let the bad guys destroy Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Aranakula
dialogues.text: The nurseries will be revived too, right...?

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: But Marana is still here. Aranara have a lot to do.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh, you're so strict, Arabalika. We've finished one thing, haven't we? Just let Aranakula be happy for a bit!

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: Hmph.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Same old Arabalika.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh*... Paimon doesn't know what will satisfy him.

dialogues.speaker: Arabalika
dialogues.text: No sense of urgency. Paimon is careless. Will get into trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon's heard that one before. Paimon's not careless! Paimon's always careful!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Looks like somebody hasn't learned their lesson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh right, {NICKNAME}. Wasn't there something else we wanted to ask Arapandu?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the children of Vimara Village...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's about the odd things that have happened in Vimara Village to the east. The children living there sometimes disappear for a period of time, but will always return safely...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's sure that you Aranara know more about the forest than we do. It would be great if you do know something.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Strange things about Vimara Village... Arapandu doesn't know now, but Arapandu will make a note of it. Other Aranara might know.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Arapandu will return to Vanarana later. Perhaps the answer will emerge then.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #About the Varuna Contraption... Nara {NICKNAME}, now you know that Aranara music can control the contraption.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Hmm. {NICKNAME}, you've studied Aranara music before as well, right? Does that mean that we can control the Varuna Contraption too?

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, like Nara Varuna, has been proven to be worthy of Aranara's friendship.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: Arapandu is willing to teach you the music to control the Varuna Contraption.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great! But will we really have to go so deep underground every time we play...

dialogues.speaker: Arakunti
dialogues.text: Paimon is not very smart. The Varuna Contraption gets power from all over Vana...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So you can also control the Varuna Contraption from other parts of Vana.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, that's Aranara trivia! You can't expect us to recall all that!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You master the Rhythm of the Source Water.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: #Nara {NICKNAME}, Paimon, thank you for your help. Vana will never forget this, and neither will Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I hope to see you at Festival Utsava.

dialogues.speaker: Arapandu
dialogues.text: We will meet again in Vanarana. May you have a carefree time, Golden Nara, and may Aramuhukunda watch over you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's even more impressive when you see it up close...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, Paimon ate the soup Arapas made earlier. That was made with the water from here, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: His soup doesn't have a special effect, right...
